title: Robustness deep-dive: FFPE/low-input/low-purity failure analysis
context: M4 robustness analysis for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Drills into where and why callers fail under FFPE-like degradation, low input, and low tumour purity, using the stratified results. The aim is honest characterisation of failure modes (not a winner), so users understand the limits of each tool. Built on simulated/open data with full provenance; no clinical claim is made.
objective: Produce a robustness deep-dive analysing caller failure modes across FFPE/low-input/low-purity strata, with CI-bounded evidence and provenance links.
acceptanceCriteria: Failure analysis covers FFPE-like degradation, low-input, and low-purity strata with per-stratum CI + n.
Each finding is provenance-linked to benchmark runs; limitations stated; no winner declared.
